# netbox_power_feed (Data Source)

Reads a single NetBox power feed (`/api/dcim/power-feeds/`) by `id`, `name` or filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
data "netbox_power_feed" "example" {
  name = "example"
}

# Lookup by arbitrary API filters:
data "netbox_power_feed" "filtered" {
  filters = [
    { name = "id", value = "123" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes List) Additional query filters as name/value pairs, e.g. `{ name = "tenant_id", value = "12" }`. Any query parameter of `/api/dcim/power-feeds/` is accepted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `name` (String) Name.

### Read-Only

- `amperage` (Number) Amperage. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `cable_end` (String) Cable End.
- `cable_id` (Number) Cable. References `netbox_cable`.
- `comments` (String) Comments. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `connected_endpoints_reachable` (Boolean) Connected Endpoints Reachable.
- `connected_endpoints_type` (String) Connected Endpoints Type.
- `created` (String) Created.
- `custom_fields` (String) Custom field values as a JSON object (`jsonencode({...})`). Only keys present in the configuration are tracked.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `display_url` (String) Display Url.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `link_peers_type` (String) Return the type of the peer link terminations, or None.
- `mark_connected` (Boolean) Treat as if a cable is connected. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `max_utilization` (Number) Maximum permissible draw (percentage). Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `occupied` (Boolean) Occupied.
- `owner_id` (Number) ID of the Owner (`netbox_owner`).
- `phase` (String) Phase. Valid values: `single-phase`, `three-phase`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `power_panel_id` (Number) ID of the Power Panel (`netbox_power_panel`).
- `rack_id` (Number) ID of the Rack (`netbox_rack`).
- `status` (String) Status. Valid values: `offline`, `active`, `planned`, `failed`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `supply` (String) Supply. Valid values: `ac`, `dc`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to this object. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `tenant_id` (Number) ID of the Tenant (`netbox_tenant`).
- `type` (String) Type. Valid values: `primary`, `redundant`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `url` (String) Url.
- `voltage` (Number) Voltage. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.

### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Query parameter name.
- `value` (String) Query parameter value.
